note:
1891 RG12/2682, schedules 140 to 145 - the six households between Sunny Side and 5 Clare Valley.

Read from the enumerator's pages supplied by A. Hagues on 26 September 2026, and transcribed to
settle where Sunny Side stood. Schedule 139 is Sunny Side with its street given as a ditto of Park
Valley, and schedule 140 opens Huntingdon Drive - so Sunny Side is the last house on Park Valley
before the enumerator turns.

The Clare Valley houses are numbered from the walk. Only five houses stood on the street in 1891:
the four named houses at the cul-de-sac end - Grove House, Ribble Lodge, Springdale and The Spinney
- were built between 1905 and 1916, and the five of about 1890 are numbers 1 to 5. Schedules 142 to
146 are exactly five consecutive Clare Valley households, and 146 is already filed at number 5, so
142 to 145 are 1 to 4.

Huntingdon Drive is left unfiled. Nothing on the page numbers it, and the record has no anchor for
that street in this round. One house on Huntingdon Drive is marked uninhabited between schedules
141 and 142; it is not recorded as unoccupied because there is no number to record it against.

Schedule 143 is named Ivedene, a house name the record has not held before.
source: 1891 census RG12/2682, schedules 140-145 - Huntingdon Drive and Clare Valley, transcribed by A. Hagues.
